scope.claims: Pure-export behavior only. This report makes no pipeline, causality, source-acquisition, or trading claim.

observations.observation: Three rows carrying event EVENT-MEMORY-PRICING-01 collapse to one cluster. The cluster retains three tickers, two named sources, and rowCount 3.
The current heuristic merges EVENT-MU-GUIDANCE-RAISE-01 and EVENT-MU-GUIDANCE-CUT-01 into one cluster because the shared headline tokens exceed the overlap threshold.

omissions: A catalyst set built from this cluster cannot expose both distinct event identities.
observations.qualification: This is a semantic clustering failure in the pure export, not evidence about any live corpus or pipeline output.

observations.observation: At max 4, the set retains one earnings item, one SEC item, and two news items for MU with dense IDs 1-4. EVENT-MU-GRANT-01 is omitted and remains named in the fixture/report.

observations.uiLabel: One member can consume the catalyst cap
observations.observation: Six newer tier-1 SNDK stories consume max 6 before MU's older tier-1 company event. The output contains no MU item.
observations.qualification: buildCatalystSet receives no member-move input, so this confirms a breadth limitation under the proposed UI contract; it is not labeled a regression in the current ranking contract.

observations.uiLabel: Cutoff must be applied before clustering
observations.observation: When supplied directly, the pure exports retain one post-cutoff row, one row first observed after cutoff, and one undated row. A research-side publication-plus-first-observation cutoff retains only EVENT-MU-BEFORE-CUTOFF-01; the undated catalyst otherwise carries null date, at, and age.
omissions: The exports expose no original first-observation field and accept no cutoff parameter; firstObservedAt is preserved only as frozen harness metadata.
observations.qualification: This characterizes the function boundary only. It does not claim that a caller or live pipeline fails to filter these rows.

observations.uiLabel: No headline means no company-specific catalyst
observations.observation: The syndicated cluster retains SNDK and MU breadth. WDC has no input row and receives no catalyst; no sympathy or causal relationship is inferred.
omissions: buildCatalystSet emits one ticker label and does not carry the cluster's full ticker breadth into each catalyst item.
observations.qualification: Related-member metadata is fixture context only.

missingCases: No desired-contract rule establishes whether an undated row may become eligible from first-observation time alone; this harness keeps it cutoff-ineligible.
No fixture tests a catalyst that changes publisher tier after clustering.
No fixture tests more than six competing earnings or SEC items because those paths already have focused coverage and would not exercise the requested member-breadth gap.
notice: All headlines, prices, dates and publisher attributions in these test scenarios are invented. Real ticker names do not make them historical evidence.
